title: Japan says to advance ICC funding after US sanctions

blocks.text: TOKYO, Japan — Tokyo said Tuesday it will pay its annual contributions to the International Criminal Court in advance after the United States targeted it with sanctions. The US in October imposed sweeping sanctions on the ICC that threaten to cripple its operations, with court officials concerned about access to banking among other issues. Following a meeting between ICC President Tomoko Akane of Japan and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi Tuesday, Tokyo said it had decided to pay its full 2027 contribution by the end of the year “in order to support the ICC as its largest financial contributor”.
